name: Deteriorating patient
blurb: Fever, confusion, abnormal vitals: NEWS2, qSOFA, eGFR
text: 78-year-old woman from a care home with new confusion since this morning. Fever and productive cough for 2 days. T 38.9, HR 124, RR 28, BP 92/54, SpO2 90% on 2L nasal cannula. Creatinine 2.0 mg/dL. On metformin 1000 mg twice daily and lisinopril 20 mg daily. Allergic to penicillin. Denies chest pain.

name: Shorthand ED note
text: 58-year-old man c/o CP and SOB x2h, diaphoretic, N/V. PMHx: HTN, T2DM, HLD. Mother had MI. Denies fever. BP 172/104, HR 112, SpO2 95% on room air, T 37.1, alert. On ASA and metformin 500 mg BD.

name: Possible diabetes
blurb: Labs and vitals feed the risk model
text: Female, 45-year-old. Reports increased thirst, frequent urination and fatigue for 3 weeks, with blurred vision. BMI 33. Fasting glucose 182 mg/dL, HbA1c 8.1%. BP 128/84 mmHg. Family history of diabetes. Not currently on any treatment.

name: Chest pain, full workup
blurb: All 13 UCI fields run the heart model
text: 62-year-old male smoker with hypertension, taking lisinopril and aspirin. Presents with chest pressure radiating to the left arm, shortness of breath and sweating since this morning. BP 168/98 mmHg. Total cholesterol 262 mg/dL.
